works.title: Projects
works.subtitle: A curated index of procedural animation, product visualization, fluid and cloth simulations, and pipeline tools.

projects.title: Fabric Dynamics
projects.description: Procedural cloth simulation with dynamic wind forces and collision systems for a fashion brand campaign.
projects.assignment: Atelier Nord asked for a film that captured fabric in motion without cinematography on set. The brief was to translate the soul of their craft into a fully procedural language — touchable, but unmistakably digital.
projects.solution: We rebuilt the garment as a Vellum cloth solver, layered wind forces driven by attribute noise, and trained the collision passes to behave like ghosted bodies. Lookdev was matched 1:1 to studio reference, and the comp finished in After Effects with a single soft grade.
projects.context: Delivered as a 60-second hero film and ten 9:16 cutdowns for retail screens. Every shot is rendered from the same source — direction shifts only happen at the camera level.

projects.title: Tech Product Launch
projects.description: High-end product visualization for a consumer electronics launch. Full pipeline from modeling to final composite.
projects.assignment: A consumer tech brand needed a launch film that would survive being intercut with live keynote footage. Build geometry tight enough for macro shots, light it without studio cliché, and finish in a comp pipeline a small team could maintain.
projects.solution: Modeling was authored in Blender with USD references kept identical to the engineering CAD. Lookdev used a thin-film and brushed-metal stack reused across the SKU family. Compositing in After Effects wrapped everything in a calm, broadcast-safe grade.
projects.context: Used in launch keynote, product page hero loop, and global retail signage. Eight SKUs delivered from a single shot graph.

projects.title: Particle Universe
projects.description: Procedural particle system creating organic, data-driven motion graphics for a fintech brand film.
projects.assignment: Northwind wanted abstract motion that felt like a living index — populated, calm, never random. The brief explicitly avoided any literal interpretation of trading or markets.
projects.solution: We built a single Houdini particle setup driven by attribute volumes and a hand-curated set of attractors. Each frame is the same simulation, time-shifted, so editing was done in the timeline instead of in solver space.
projects.context: Delivered as a 90-second master plus a library of loops for stage screens, social, and the brand site. The same scene file shipped four years of campaign assets.

projects.title: Liquid Metal
projects.description: Metallic fluid simulation with custom shader development for an automotive brand commercial.
projects.assignment: A new vehicle was inbound and the agency wanted the body to feel as if it cast itself out of mercury. The work had to read on a phone and on a 30-metre LED wall.
projects.solution: FLIP simulation was directed via collision proxies of the final geometry; surface tension and curvature drove a thin-film shader baked from a measured BRDF. Renders were composited with a single matte luminance pass.
projects.context: A 45-second hero spot and three brand idents. The simulation cache was reused as B-roll for the entire model line.

projects.title: Trim Texture Assembler
projects.description: Pipeline tool for automated trim texture assembly, reducing manual atlas work by 80%.
projects.assignment: Trim sheet authoring was the largest manual cost in a recurring archviz pipeline. The brief was to make it disappear.
projects.solution: A Python service ingests source artwork, normalises padding and resolution, and emits a texture set with metadata. Houdini and Blender both consume the same JSON, which means downstream artists never touch the assembler.
projects.context: Adopted across three studios. The current build assembles 64-channel atlases in under three minutes.

projects.title: Annual Motion Reel
projects.description: Compilation reel demonstrating a full production cycle across motion design and CG.
projects.assignment: Cut a year of work into 90 seconds without losing the technical signature of each project — the brief was less a reel and more a tasting menu.
projects.solution: Selections were graded into a single calm look. Sound design was built around a slow pulse that lets each shot read on its own. Edit was paced for muted playback.
projects.context: Lives at the top of the works page and is the only piece on the site that auto-plays. Updated annually.
